basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to live in sophisticated remodeled SF home where there's room for everyone, views for days & you know your neighbors! With timeless modern kitchen & baths; new roof(2025), updated systems & smart home features go beyond surface.  Enter main floor through tunnel entry to spacious, bright great room w/open living, dining & kitchen. Down the hall 3 large bdrms, serviced by oversized bath w/ double sink, bring breathtaking views and flex space.  A short flight down, massive primary offers privacy w/proximity to upper floor and the same East Bay outlooks. Laundry is also located on this floor.  Tucked away below, 5th bdrm is perfect home office. Additionally, a family room on this floor opens to new deck, pergola and whimsical eco-garden- ideal entertaining and play space.  Garage has 1 EV pkg & internal access to adorable mudroom. Driveway pkg for car #2. Walkable to Glen Park, conveniences, transportation & desirable schools, this quiet Sunnyside block is ideal! EZ commute w 280/101 nearby.
